notes.title: Pricing drop!
notes.content: [h1][b]What's up everyone![/b][/h1][p][/p][p][b]I have decided to lower the price of Tiny Kings after realizing that the previous set price was too high for the amount of bug I started finding. I am very sorry for the lack of quality in the initial EA release and not changing the price earlier. I'm still learning the ropes of launching a game, but I'll get used to it![/b] [/p][p][/p][h2][b]On a positive note![/b][/h2][p][b]I am continuing to work on a MAJOR update to Tiny Kings that will be bringing lots of great changes to gameplay, as well as fix up all those pesky bugs. Don't expect the update to come out at lighting speed (I am the only programmer on our very small team), but I can't wait for you all to try it![/b][/p][p][/p][p][b]If you have purchased Tiny Kings before the price change:  [/b][b][i]July 19, 9:00 p.m EST [/i][/b][b]let me know if you would like a compensation. If it is something most people would like, I will absolutely look into making that happen! You can let me know in the Discord Server, Steam Groups, or by commenting on this post.[/b][/p][p][/p][p]Anyway, that's all for this announcement! Hope you all have a good day, see you in the next announcement! [/p]

notes.title: June 26 Hotfix
notes.content: [p]Well, a launch wouldn't be complete without finding some bugs right after.[/p][p][/p][list][*][p]Fixed a balance issue with archers[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed a bug that wouldn't erase your save after losing (which also caused a crash when loading the game)[/p][/*][*][p]Tweaked starting resources to be a bit more balanced[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed a glitch that wouldn't have enemies spawn after saving[/p][/*][/list][p][/p]

notes.title: In-game Resource Update and Thank you
notes.content:
[p]Hey everyone![/p][p][/p][p][b]We’ve got a two announcements to share today as we approach release day![/b][/p][p][/p][p]In play testing we have found that Stone and Wood resources felt clunky and incomplete. We feel that in its current state it overcomplicates the game. We apologize for such late notice of this, but we don’t want to release an incomplete feature. Do not worry though, as we plan to bring Stone and Wood back in a later update. As you can see by this amazing graph, we predict Tiny Kings’ awesomeness level to increase as more updates are pushed out![/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45478747/370714fa238628f5afff7349658871a95c5d207b.jpg"][/img][/p][p][/p][p]The second announcement is something I am very grateful for.
Tiny Kings has over [b]100 wishlists[/b]! I want to thank you for all the support, it really means a lot. From humble beginnings as a game-jam game to a full release on Steam. Creating and expanding Tiny Kings had been a great journey! On behalf of the team, I thank you all for your support and can’t wait to see your kingdoms and hear your feedback.[/p]
